name: University College Absalon
about: Absalon is a university college on Zealand. Its English-taught engineering degrees are based at the 2021 Kalundborg campus, in a small international study environment close to biotechnology and production companies. Biotechnology includes a company internship; Robot Systems starts in September 2027.
knownFor: Engineering projects and internships with Kalundborg industry

languageOfInstruction.note: Absalon says three of its programmes are taught fully or partly in English. Only the two engineering degrees in Kalundborg are fully in English.

notes: Absalon was formerly University College Sjælland; the accreditation authority records positive institutional accreditation on 3 June 2021. Both English engineering degrees are taught in Kalundborg. The wider institution has other campuses.
Education in Vordingborg begins in English but is taught partly in Danish and requires Danish during the degree; it is outside this fully English degree list.

Apply through Optagelse.dk by 15 March at 12:00 noon CET, including an IB earned in Denmark. The published annual deadline is provisional for 2027. Monitor nemStudie for individual document requests and the reply deadline in the admission letter.

The engineering FAQ allows preliminary results and expected subject-hours evidence before 5 July noon when the final exam arrives later, before 1 September. The application pages specifically allow EU summer finishers to declare this. Same-year non-EU IB eligibility and an exact final-IB delivery deadline need confirmation.

EU/EEA citizens pay no tuition. Other applicants normally pay DKK 3,750 before assessment; it is non-refundable unless admitted, when it is credited to tuition. Current published full-programme tuition is DKK 500,302.58; the table is undated for 2027 and fees may change. From September 2026, tuition-paying students pay the first year in advance.

Both engineering degrees require English B. If the qualifying exam lacks that level, accepted tests are IELTS 6.5, TOEFL 4.5 (94 for tests before 21 January 2026), or Cambridge C1 Advanced/C2 Proficiency 180; results must be no older than two years at the application deadline.

Robot Systems currently gives 65% of places to quota 1 (Danish GPA at least 5.0, ranked by GPA) and 35% to quota 2 (ranked interview scores). Biotechnology requires an interview from every quota 2 applicant. Meeting requirements does not guarantee a place.

Robot Systems puts its internship in semester five, while its fee table puts the low-fee semester in semester six. Confirm the payment schedule before budgeting. Absalon says it cannot offer scholarships.
